products.name: Submagic
products.note: Auto-caption AI; video subtitles; emoji/sticker automation; EU vendor

profile_text.body:
Submagic is a video editing tool aimed at short-form content creators. The company describes itself as enabling users to edit short videos significantly faster using AI, with the platform automatically detecting highlights, adding captions, and formatting clips for short-form platforms after a video is uploaded. Users can edit the output as text and export within minutes.

The core product, also called Submagic, sits in the video generation and editing category and centers on automated captioning and subtitle generation. Additional features listed on the site include AI-generated b-roll, auto-zoom, sound effects, video translation, and podcast clip creation, alongside a set of free creator tools covering thumbnails, video scripts, hashtag suggestions, and caption generation for platforms such as TikTok and Instagram. The held facts note that Submagic is an EU-based vendor.
